text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Cancer.

The clinical picture of postmenopausal bleeding in a 65-year-old woman is highly suspicious for endometrial carcinoma until proven otherwise. Please confirm the results of the Transvaginal Ultrasound (TVUS) regarding the endometrial stripe thickness and provide the imaging of the adnexal mass described.
